Their customer service department is like talking to a dead end: "We've taken note of your complaint and will pass it on to the relevant department." "We can't put you through to anyone." "We don't know what to tell you; the relevant department will handle it."
I've requested to cancel the contract, have everything installed removed, and receive a full refund. No response.
What a bunch of crooks!
Based on my experience, anyone who can avoid them should do so.

one_star_reviews.text:
We didn't go to the insurance department.
We bought a set of towels (€70), and when I asked to validate the parking ticket, they told me that since I didn't pay with my El Corte Inglés card, I had to pay for it. I was planning to have lunch with my wife (the cafeteria is on the same floor) and go down to buy the Pink Floyd "Wish You Were Here 50th Anniversary" CD, but I didn't do either of those things when I found out that parking isn't free for customers.
We left with the towels because I imagine I wouldn't have been able to return them once I'd paid for them; otherwise, I would have left them there too.
I think it's outrageous that they charge you for parking if you don't use their card.
It had been a while since I'd driven to this store.
Now they shouldn't expect me to come. Not by car, not on foot.
I'm not saying they should roll out the red carpet. But come on, if you've made a purchase, the least they could do is let you park for free.
They're despicable.

Very unprofessional, to say the least. I called them interested in viewing a property, and after telling them my availability (after 4:30 pm), they replied that they have summer hours, from 8 am to 3 pm. Like everyone else, I suppose.

And that's what I told them. That I do too.
To which they replied that they would speak with their colleague and get back to me.
Five days passed, and I had to call them to ask. I received no response. I wrote to them again, and they told me that the real estate agent was on vacation and the colleague was out showing properties.
It's incredibly unprofessional not to tell a potential client this from the beginning.
This was on September 1st. It's now the 8th, and no one has contacted me.
I think you should extend your vacation and just close the business.
Regards.

one_star_reviews.text:
I haven't used AI or ChatGPT to make this review as I wanted it to be as accurate as possible...

Our group of 12 originally booked a villa in Mil Palmeras for dates in August 2026. We were let down at last minute and had our booking cancelled. We had to frantically search for a villa to accommodate 12 people. We found Mufasa villa in Calpe. We were surprised that we were able to find somewhere at such short notice but were happy to have a villa.
On our first day, we were told that we couldn't check in until 4pm, no problem, this is a regular thing for villas as they need to clean etc, we didn't have a problem. We got to the villa around 4.30pm and the key wouldn't unlock the door. We tried every which way to open it, including some pretty big lads trying to push it open. We didn't want to cause damage to the door so called the villa company, they sent out a young lady who managed to kick the door in about 4 different places and rattle the handle a certain way to open it. She had obviously had this problem before, but it was not fixed??
Anyway, on entering the villa we were shocked to find there was no air conditioning. This is in Calpe in August when temperatures reach above 40°C. The saving grace was that the some rooms had a ceiling fan, almost strong enough to blow out a candle and a couple rooms had industrial sized fans that sounded like an airplane taking off. Not a great start but we move.
The next morning we woke up sweating, excited to make the most of our new villa and it's pool. We had 6 children with us who couldn't wait. We had a little bit of a wait though as an infestation of wasps had pre booked the pool and surrounding areas. No bother though, they will go eventually and we had to go shopping for essentials so would pick up a few citronella candles to keep them at bay. At around midday and after lighting approximately 9 citronella candles round the pool, we managed to get in. After about 14 minutes of 4 or 5 people playing in the pool, we were able to extract more than a few handfuls of tiles that had come loose around the pool and put them to one side. And the ph levels in the pool changed the colour of your swimming shorts which was nice. At least the view of the overgrown plants and weeds in the patio took our thoughts away from bleeding feet.
In the evening after catching a few rays, some kids wanted to have a rest from the sun and check their devices, as kids do....one problem..WiFi didn't work. Again, not at a problem, we will contact the company/owner and have this fixed in no time. They must have been expected us and had a WiFi repair kit at the ready as it took a quick 5 days to get repaired. Brilliant swift response and only cost us a small fortune in roaming costs between us, brilliant!!
When we had gone shopping for the 12 people staying there, we had obviously bought enough for a few days at a time. Unfortunately the lego sized fridge couldn't stock up all our products, but what can go wrong with leaving food out in a sauna of a villa with an insect infestation?? The fridge also had a smaller compartment at the bottom, which looks like the type area you can store frozen goods, however this new high tech fridge must disagree with frozen goods as it kept as much cold in, as an igloo in the Sahara. I won't call it a freezer, it will be called a cold fridge.
Never mind though, we'll get to cooking and we won't need to worry about storing food. I initially wasnt aware of the mufasa villa tradition of using utensils and then without cleaning them, putting back in the drawer. How authentic!! All drawers emptied and put in the dishwasher. Lucky the kind villa owner left us 1 dishwasher tablet, what a sweetheart. Dishwasher finished, and I was pleasantly surprised to find that all utensils were nearly 50% clean, what a result. Very economical this villa with the power saving on the fridge/cold fridge and dishwiper.

If I could put minus *'s i would.
Never book this villa, not even for as a challenge or a dare.
Rubbish

one_star_reviews.text: Hey everybody. Im Tom and I go to Rototom since more than 15 years. This year i was shoked about the capitalistic and inhuman development of the festival. For example u hat to pay 105 Euro for changing the name of the ticket I got from a friend who could not come because of family issues. 105 Euro!! For something i did on my own. Another example was at the ending of a dub session at dub academy. I was so touched and my heart was so opened up by the incredible music I just enjoyed. I was meditating with closed eyes next to the dancefloor, when a steward touched me and forced my out of my meditative state, told me to leave immediatly. I told him how vulnerable and open hearted I was in this moment and asked him if a can stay sitting for just another minute to process my impressions. He yelled at me, saying he had to work all night and wants to finish his shift. Well Rototom is not about your work, its about Rastafari music and culture and spreading its values, teachings and love, or at least I thought so… This year they treated us (proud Rastafari and Reggae lovers) like sheep or cows, who have to leave right after the concerts, like 💵, but not like humans!Not like Rastafari! I realized that Rototom is no longer a place for real Rastafari and Rastafariculture! It has become a place for drunk, ignorant sheep and capitalistc values. I hereby exclaim to boycott Rototom until it changed its goals and I warn the Committee of Rototom of the charmic consequences of making profit out of Rastafariculture. ☮️&❤️ Tom

one_star_reviews.text:
On June 18th, I went to the branch to ask the manager, María, a question. My question was simple: I wanted to know if I could apply for a specific type of mortgage while on leave to care for my children. I was told that I would receive an answer within 24 to 48 hours of receiving the documents.

Okay. That same day, I sent all the documentation for evaluation. My family already had a mortgage approved at another bank, but BBVA's terms were better, so we decided to wait.

After an ordeal—a ton of unanswered calls, unanswered emails, and numerous visits to the branch to get any information at all—on July 24th, the manager handling our case finally told us it was approved. That same day, she told us she was going on vacation on the 25th. I simply asked who would be in charge of the process in her absence, and she said a colleague who was returning from vacation the following week.

So, I called that colleague on the 27th to explain our situation and ask her to keep me updated, but she said she was busy with other people at the time. This meant we ended up talking the next day, July 28th, when she told me, as if she were doing us a favor, "María said she'll take care of it while she's on vacation."

This was a major setback, as we now had no direct contact at the bank. Since we couldn't ask anyone else, we put our trust in this person again and just waited for news, as we couldn't even get in touch with her.

On Friday, August 7th, I received an email from the manager around 8:00 PM informing me that the mortgage signing could only take place once my leave of absence ended and I returned to work. This was exactly the first question she had asked almost two months earlier.
My family was stunned. Not only were we caught off guard by the timing (since our little one starts school at the beginning of September), but we simply couldn't complete the transaction. Due to family logistics, canceling the leave of absence was impossible because we had to take care of our child, so we had no choice but to go back to the bank that had granted us the mortgage before contacting BBVA. They processed everything and resolved it in four days. Four days.
I certainly don't know if it's a problem with the management of this particular branch or with BBVA in general, but for one bank to give you an answer in four to ten days while another takes a month and three weeks is, without a doubt, alarming. Interest rates had risen, and now we're going to have to pay more. Not only have we lost time and money, but no one has apologized or contacted us to say, "Hey, I didn't get the information right" or "We made a mistake."

I also work in customer service and I know that problems can sometimes arise, but that doesn't excuse the fact that, when they do happen, an apology should at least be issued. It's a disgrace.

The new manager's customer service was a complete disaster. After the change in management in January 2026, I ended up transferring all my accounts to another bank, as it was utterly impossible to communicate with her.

one_star_reviews.text:
We visited Hillsong Madrid just 7 days after moving to Spain, after living in Bratislava, Slovakia, for four years.
We have been Christians for many years and, while living in Slovakia, we attended an international church where services were in English. So you can imagine how excited we were to hear a sermon in Spanish again. We have also followed Hillsong en Español and its music for years, so we were genuinely excited to finally visit the church in Madrid.
Our first impression was very positive. The atmosphere was beautiful, and I especially want to mention the person working in security, who introduced himself as such and was extremely kind and welcoming to us. Thank you for the way you treated us that day.
Unfortunately, after the service we had an experience that left us feeling quite disappointed.

Bibles were being given out, and we got excited and asked if we could have one for our 7-year-old daughter. The person handing them out asked us, rather abruptly, whether this would be our first Bible. We explained that it would not, as we have been Christians and attending church for many years. We were then simply told that we would not be given one because we already knew God.
I politely said that I didn’t feel the way the situation was being handled was right. Instead of explaining the criteria or simply saying kindly that the Bibles were intended for people who had never owned one, the person turned their back on me.
What made the experience even more confusing was what happened immediately afterwards. Another woman was asked if this would be her first Bible. She said no, that she had always been a Christian, and she was then given one warmly.

I want to make something very clear: this review is not about not receiving a free Bible. If the Bibles were specifically intended for people who had never had one before, we would completely understand and respect that. What hurt was the way we were treated and then seeing someone else in essentially the same situation treated completely differently.
We know there are no perfect people in church. We certainly aren’t perfect either. We are Christians ourselves, and we love God. But perhaps that is exactly why this experience hurt. The way we treat someone walking through the doors of a church for the first time matters.
The church itself felt very youthful, and at least on the day we visited, we noticed relatively few families with children. Perhaps that was something we should have considered before visiting as well.

We left with mixed feelings. We had arrived with so much excitement, especially after years of living abroad and finally being able to worship and hear a sermon in Spanish again. Some people made us feel genuinely welcome, but unfortunately this experience ended up defining much of our first visit.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience was rather unpleasant because of the waitress who served me, a plump woman with short, dyed-white hair and glasses. I ordered an orange Aquarius (a type of lemonade) and saw fried anchovies, which I liked, along with bread, but she didn't give me a fork; I had to eat them by hand. Her manner was very curt; it made me feel like I was begging for charity.

I worked in the hospitality industry for 15 years and never treated anyone that way because, first and foremost, you are the face of this establishment, and the image and the customer who pays deserve at least some level of service. It's not uncommon for someone to have problems at home and bring them up again when they return. There are also very difficult and strange customers, which I saw a lot during the years I worked.

The conclusion of this experience is a piece of advice for everyone: go to restaurants and cafes less often, or almost never, if you're only going to encounter unpleasant experiences and food that's inedible at exorbitant prices. In short, it's no wonder that places close every year.

Good luck to everyone

one_star_reviews.text:
I'm giving it one star because it won't let me give it less. In my case of permanent partial disability resulting from a work accident, I had to take matters into my own hands and find out which insurance brokerage handled the company's accident insurance. I also had to get the contribution table for the day of my accident myself. In almost four years, I barely saw him three times, and the last time I had to go before 9:00 a.m. to be outside his office. In September 2025, I learned through my citizen's file for justice that the Supreme Court had ruled in my favor. I spent two weeks trying to locate him. I had to go to the Social Court No. 1 in Ferrol, and if it weren't for the court clerk who gave me the documents so that Santander Bank could pay me, this man wouldn't have provided them to me. He also closed a deal WITHOUT MY CONSENT OR SIGNATURE AND WITHOUT MY PRESENCE, IN WHICH, ACCORDING TO HIM, I WAIVED MY RIGHT TO REQUEST FURTHER FINANCIAL COMPENSATION FROM THE INSURANCE COMPANY. Do you want to know what this man hasn't asked me for, telling me I'm not entitled to it when I am?

--Psychophysical damage (sequelae): I have 55 points for ischemic heart disease, approximately €90,000.

--Permanent loss of quality of life (I have 8 stents in 3 coronary arteries), severe degree due to relapse (dyspnea at rest), table 2B...approximately €65,000.

--Temporary injury (sick leave): I was off work for 18 months, a total of 547 days. Each day is paid separately from the sick leave payment at €67.96, so they owe me a total of €37,174.12.

--Surgical procedures (two catheterizations) at €2,500 each.

In total, out of approximately €200,000, after deducting the €10,500 from the insurance already received, this gentleman has stopped claiming €189,674.12 from me.

Luckily, I realized this in time, before a year had passed since I received the accident insurance payment, and to prevent the claim from expiring, I have already sent certified letters to Lidl and Randstad.

And then he has the nerve to force me into a pre-trial conciliation hearing because I don't want to pay him, even though the agreement was made in 2022 over the phone, sir, and it was only 10 percent of the total once the proceedings are finalized. And now he sends me a bill for over 4,000 euros! Are you kidding me? I had already been warned that this man could pull a fast one on me. Something shady happened, and it wasn't a lie. On October 1st, I have a conciliation hearing with him, which I will refuse. Furthermore, I still have emails with him asking him to claim certain things from me, and he either didn't reply or told me I had no right to them. So tell me, why is it that in a law firm in A Coruña, paying 150 euros per consultation, I am entitled to what you have wronged me with?

After everything I've been through, the worst thing I ever did was trust this surgeon. I underwent rhinoplasty hoping to solve both an aesthetic and functional problem, and I ended up feeling deeply disappointed and neglected. What hurts the most isn't just the result, but the feeling of abandonment when I later had problems and needed answers. I tried to contact him to explain that I was having difficulty breathing, and I didn't even get a response that addressed my situation. Ultimately, I had to go back to the operating room to try to fix the remaining issues.

I feel terrible for having placed my trust and my health in someone from whom I expected professionalism, follow-up, and responsibility. If I could go back, I would never have decided to have surgery with him. Before undergoing any surgery, I recommend doing extensive research and considering not only the initial result but also how the professional responds when complications arise.

one_star_reviews.text:
Very bad experience. Not recommended at all.

We rented a car and, from the beginning, the experience was quite poor. The vehicle didn't have a reflective vest or a V16 light. Furthermore, right when we picked up the car, they informed us that sixth gear wasn't working, something we believe they should have told us before we went to collect it.

The most worrying thing happened upon return. When we handed over the car, they inspected it and told us everything was fine, and they returned our deposit. However, approximately four hours later, they charged us back the deposit, claiming alleged damage to a tire.

We find this completely opaque, especially after they had inspected the car in our presence, confirmed that everything was correct, and returned our deposit.

If they can claim for any alleged damage that appears several hours after we've returned the vehicle, what guarantees does the customer have? Under these conditions, tomorrow they could say a part of the car is missing, or even the engine, and try to charge the customer for it.

We expected a serious and professional company, but our experience has been quite the opposite. We do not recommend renting here and certainly will not be doing so again.

A rather unpleasant experience. I went to the store intending to buy some shoes for my mother. I tried on a size 38, but when I saw that it didn't fit, I asked for a 38.5.

Finally, instead of looking for a solution or simply explaining the available options, they decided to close, and the cashier's attitude was quite unpleasant and unprofessional. I completely understand that a store has closing hours, but there are ways and ways to treat a customer.

I left without being able to buy the shoes and, above all, with a very bad impression due to the lack of willingness to help and the way they treated me. A shame, because I went there with every intention of buying them.

Then they complain that there's no money or customers, but come on, they must be rich... I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

My father-in-law passed away in Germany and needed to be repatriated to Spain. Initially, Nuria Serrano was very kind and supportive of my mother-in-law, even assuring us that, even if the funeral was on a Saturday or Sunday, she would be there with us and available for anything we needed.

However, coordination problems began. Nuria didn't have any information about my father-in-law's flight, and I was the one who personally called the German funeral home and immediately obtained the flight number, airline, time, and arrival airport.

Later, we changed the destination from Mont-roig to Reus, and Nuria assured us that this wouldn't pose any problems. However, on Friday, she informed us that this very change had complicated the paperwork. Initially, Germany was blamed, but when I called them personally, they indicated that the matter was now under Spanish jurisdiction.

The worst part was that they told us Europe Assistance stopped working at 5:00 PM and didn't work Saturdays or Sundays, so my father-in-law would have to wait until Monday. I wasn't satisfied with that: I looked up Europe Assistance's phone number online and called. They told me something completely different: they worked until 7:00 PM and could arrange the transfer if they received the necessary approval. They even contacted the funeral home themselves, and finally, on Saturday, my father-in-law was on his way to Reus. Throughout this whole ordeal, Europe Assistance kept me informed; we didn't receive a single call from the funeral home to reassure us or explain the situation.

Nuria Serrano wasn't at the funeral either, despite having personally assured us that she would be there with us. We ran into her by chance on the street in Reus, and she told us we would see each other later. We never saw her again.

Furthermore, when we went to see my father-in-law, the room had a dirty floor and remnants of flowers, apparently from the previous service. Their own flowers hadn't arrived yet, nor had the funeral reminders, which arrived later.

And the problems continued even after the cremation. We had ordered one large urn and three small ones, but when we picked up the ashes, only the large one and one small urn were ready. They had forgotten the other two. So they had to take the large one to prepare the two missing small ones.

We explained everything to another employee, who assured us that she would report it to her supervisor and that, at the very least, we would receive a call apologizing. To this day, we are still waiting.

This isn't an isolated incident, but rather an accumulation of miscommunication, conflicting information, broken promises, and mistakes at a time when a family should be able to focus solely on saying goodbye to their loved one. We expected professionalism, information, and support from Mémora. Our experience was very different.

Thank you for your response, but we would like to clarify that on September 18, 2026, we already sent a complaint via email to Mémora, explaining in detail everything that happened.

As of today, October 12, we still have not received any response.

We find it disappointing that you are now publicly asking us to contact Customer Service, when we already did so 24 days ago and are still waiting.

What we expect is not a generic response, but rather that someone will take responsibility for reviewing our complaint, provide us with an explanation of what happened, and contact our family.

We believe that, after everything that has happened during such a painful time, we deserve at least a personal and professional response.

one_star_reviews.text:
A year ago, I submitted a written complaint informing the town hall that next to my parents' house there is a plot of land overgrown with weeds, littered with trash, and filth, posing a significant fire risk, especially in the summer.

A year later, the situation is not only unchanged, but has worsened. The land is even more overgrown with weeds and littered with debris, and what is most worrying is that I haven't even received a response from the town hall.
It is very disappointing to see the lack of action regarding a problem that affects the safety of the residents and could have very serious consequences. I hope that measures will be taken as soon as possible before an incident occurs. Two weeks after submitting another complaint for the same reason, the plot remains exactly the same. The road from the cemetery to the road at the entrance to the village is so overgrown with weeds that visibility is reduced in some sections. Today, I am watching the fire in Gátova with fear; I hope it can be brought under control soon. This town hall ignores everything that has been raised for years and formally registered for over a year.

I'm not giving it a negative rating because I can't.

one_star_reviews.text: Negative experience. The facilities and animals could be in much better condition. Everything was very poorly maintained, and the animals generally looked unwell. The "guide" was unenthusiastic and completely uninformed. It may be a farm, but it's definitely not a school. It's a shame they call it a Farm-School.

Our experience at this farm school was, unfortunately, very disappointing. We went with all our Early Childhood Education students (ages 3 to 6) expecting a safe, well-organized, and educational day. However, from the very beginning, it was clear that the attitude of most of the counselors fell far short of what is expected in an environment dedicated to working with children.

The initial welcome was already discouraging: expressions of apathy, a complete lack of enthusiasm, and an attitude that conveyed they had no intention of being involved in the activity. Although the outing was planned so that the children would be accompanied only by the counselors, this proved impossible due to their lack of professionalism.

Throughout the day, we observed some very worrying situations:

- They didn't control the groups, which became scattered if the teachers didn't intervene.

- They left the children in the sun, without seeking shade or organizing adequate waiting times, despite it being over 30 degrees Celsius (86 degrees Fahrenheit). It is true that there are shaded areas on the farm, as the owner points out, but there are no shaded areas near the entrance, where the (quite long) waits took place, or during visits to the animals (some of which coincided with 3:30 p.m. and lasted for quite some time).

- They sent the students to the bathroom unsupervised, which is completely unacceptable for such young children.

- They made faces and inappropriate comments, demonstrating their lack of interest and respect for their own work.

In practice, it was the teachers who had to supervise the bathrooms, manage the groups, ensure safety, and prevent prolonged sun exposure—tasks that should have been the responsibility of the center's staff.

The situation reached its peak when, at snack time, the monitors completely disappeared and didn't even come to say goodbye to the students.

The only exception was the monitor in charge of the zip line, whose attitude was excellent, kind, and respectful to both the children and the teachers.

In short, the experience fell far short of what any educational institution would expect from a farm school. The lack of involvement, supervision, and care for the children makes this visit a prime example of what should never happen in an educational setting.

Finally, in response to the comment that things need to be done and said on-site, I completely agree, but there was no one in charge or responsible that day with whom we could communicate.

To begin with, this appalling place lacks professionalism. Alberto is a complete scoundrel! And the woman at the entrance... ugh, ugh...

Not to mention that I almost got lost trying to find this tiny clinic. Not even Napoleon traveled that far to find America! 😡

To further illustrate my point about the lack of professionalism, I'll tell you about my family's experience. My dear aunt, in the best of intentions, went to this clinic to have her veneers replaced because they were too small. Do you know what that shameless Maite did? She stuck her bare hand in her mouth! This is the last straw! What a nightmare! Furthermore, I took her to a tiny bathroom and removed her aligners, and then the woman cut them to widen them and asked if they fit properly.

I don't know what you consider professionalism, but I saw none of it!

Also, the orthodontist, Irantzu, who was treating my cousin, LEFT!!! She left without looking back, without leaving any records of my cousin's treatment, leaving her alone and helpless. Not to mention the gap she left in her bottom teeth for MONTHS, ladies and gentlemen!

Without further ado, I'm warning you about this place, and if you go, it's at your own risk.

As young people say these days, "sics seben" (a slang term for something like "sick and dirty").

one_star_reviews.text:
Why only one star? This company primarily works with the manufacturer Midea; that's what they try to sell you from the moment you walk in the door. Midea is a Chinese company and one of the world's largest air conditioner manufacturers, but it's a mass-market, low-cost manufacturer that bases its business model on bulk sales. They also sell components for supermarket air conditioners. The difference in quality compared to leading brands in the sector is enormous. This is important for your wallet because these units don't have the same durability as the major Japanese brands. So it's not a minor issue because you might pay a little less now, but in a few years you'll have to repair or replace these units, so cheap ends up being expensive.

So why do you go into this place and ask for a high-end unit and they recommend this brand? These brands offer substantial sales discounts; if a store reaches a certain number of sales, they give it significant price reductions.

But that's not all. The person running the business when I was there gave me the contact information for a technician who, according to him, was "the one who installed the most ducted air conditioning units."

We contacted this person, and he visited the location where we wanted the work done. I caught him in several serious contradictions. I'll detail a few of them: At one point, I asked him, "What is the expected lifespan of high-end ducted air conditioning units, installed according to the manufacturer's protocols and properly maintained?" His answer: "You'll be lucky if you get to 10 years without breakdowns." But on the other hand, he claimed to have been installing air conditioners for over 10 years and had never had any problems; the units were still working, except for one case of a unit that had problems due to a power surge. The inconsistency was obvious.

He then told us that he had an assistant who quit because he said €100 a day wasn't enough, and that during July he had his 13-year-old daughter helping him by handing him the tools.

At one point, he realized it was going to be very difficult, or even impossible, to do the installation I was asking for. What did he do? Was he honest and told me he didn't have the means or resources to do it? No, he tried by all means to manipulate my partner into installing split air conditioners, which are much easier and faster to install and have far less technical difficulty.

It's clear that they systematically use these practices because they work for them and they benefit from them, until you catch them red-handed and expose the underlying scheme.

Anyone who has read the comment already knows what the truth is.

one_star_reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience with Fertilab’s communication

We contacted Fertilab because we were seriously considering them for IVF treatment abroad, and unfortunately the communication experience has completely undermined our confidence in the clinic.

Our main point of contact was Xavier Costa Alos, and there has been a repeated pattern of missed emails, delays, apologies and poor follow-up.

On 25 September, Xavier apologised because he had “completely missed” an email we had sent on 19 September.

On 5 October, he apologised again and explained that their system had apparently not been notifying him when our emails came in.

We were then offered an online consultation with Dr. Casas on 20 October at 5pm, which we accepted.

We have now been contacted again with yet another apology, only to be told that the appointment we had been offered is no longer available.

At this point, the issue is not one delayed email. It is a repeated pattern of poor communication and administrative failures.

IVF is an incredibly sensitive, emotional and expensive process. Patients need to feel confident that emails will be read, appointments will be handled properly and communication will be reliable, especially when treatment can involve medication timing, scans, travel, donor arrangements and procedures that depend on coordination.

Instead, we have spent a considerable amount of time chasing replies and dealing with repeated apologies, without seeing any real improvement.

We are extremely disappointed because Fertilab initially looked like a clinic we might genuinely choose. Unfortunately, the experience with Xavier and the clinic’s communication has resulted in a complete loss of trust, and we no longer feel comfortable proceeding with them.

Very unprofessional and particularly disappointing given how delicate the IVF journey already is.

Unfortunately, my first experience with Fertilab has been very disappointing and concerning.

I had an appointment scheduled for October 29th. I was asked by email to provide some documents, but received no reminder or follow-up. More than a month before my appointment, I suddenly received a notification saying that it had been cancelled because I had not provided the documents “on time.”

I immediately emailed the clinic asking for an explanation, but received no response. Instead, I received a new appointment invitation, followed by a cancellation a few minutes later — twice.

For something as important and emotionally significant as egg freezing, I expected much better communication, organization and care. This is an important process that requires a significant emotional and personal investment, and the way this situation has been handled felt very unprofessional and upsetting.

I hope they improve the way they communicate with and support their patients.

I had surgery here and it was terrible. Dr. Carlos Beltran performed a mastopexy with implants, and I can't upload photos, but one was bigger than the other, the implant was palpable, and the scars were a finger's width thick. When I tried to explain what he had done, he told me the result was favorable... I had to have surgery again because my breasts were sagging. I have many photos. My advice, girls, don't go to this clinic. They don't tell you anything and they don't care about anything. The recovery was horrible, and he doesn't even answer messages. The scars, a finger's width thick, became infected with pus. It was awful. I had to go back into surgery with another surgeon to repair the frayed and weakened muscle that Dr. Beltran left me with. I can't upload any photos, but I have many.

I want to share my experience with Wellness Kliniek so that those considering cosmetic surgery can also learn about my case.

On September 2, 2025, I underwent a mastopexy with 320cc round, high-profile breast implants placed in the prepectoral plane, performed by Dr. Carlos Beltrán.

From the first few months, I noticed a lack of volume in the upper pole, little cleavage, asymmetries, and an implant position I wasn't happy with. One breast was larger than the other, and the scar opened up badly and filled with pus. Although I expressed my concerns at several follow-up appointments, I was told the result was fine.

The problems persisted: almost a year later, I was still dissatisfied. I could feel the implants, and I wasn't happy with the scars either. Therefore, I sought a second opinion, and on August 25, 2026, I had to undergo revision surgery in Madrid, with the associated costs, recovery, and another procedure.

According to the medical report, the muscle was very frayed and weakened. A second mastopexy was also performed.

During the follow-up appointment, it was explained to me that the muscle was weakened and deteriorated. I am providing photographs and medical documentation so that my experience can be verified.

This review reflects only my personal experience. I recommend researching thoroughly, requesting all documentation in writing, keeping photographs, and seeking a second medical opinion if you have any doubts. A picture is worth a thousand words. I can't upload photos to show what they did to me... Don't have surgery here, be careful. CARLOS BELTRAN, VERY BAD.

Dr. Carlos Beltrán did a terrible job. He left my daughter with very bad results and scarring: the implant fell out, a finger was scarred after the mastopexy, and the scarring was severed. This clinic is not recommended at all.

Spanish public authorities, Madrid City Council, tax inspectors: why don’t you take a closer look at this?

one_star_reviews.text:
Terrible management, a complete lack of trust, and utter disrespect towards the customer.

We bought a gift voucher for my son's teacher as an end-of-year gift for the whole class. When we purchased it, we were expressly assured that the voucher did not expire.

The unpleasant surprise came when the teacher went to open it and saw that it was marked as expired. After speaking with one of the managers, they admitted their mistake; however, when trying to schedule an appointment, it was flatly denied because the other partner/manager wouldn't accept it.

From then on, it was a complete disaster:

Constant back-and-forth between centers: I was transferred calls from Arenys to Mataró and vice versa for days trying to locate the responsible person.

Absolute lack of commitment: When I finally managed to speak with her to resolve the issue, she promised to call me to confirm the appointment. This happened in June, and after months and multiple attempts on my part to contact her again, I am still waiting for her call. It's a disgrace that a joint end-of-year gift should end up in such an awkward and embarrassing situation for the recipient due to the center's incompetence and lack of professionalism.

They have demonstrated appalling management and unacceptable customer service. They've lost an entire family of regular customers. I absolutely do not recommend them.

one_star_reviews.text:
I would advise potential tenants to be cautious when dealing with BekKari Inmobiliaria, based on our personal experience.

We rented an apartment on Calle Quesada in the El Zapillo area of Almería, which we found through an Idealista listing advertised to us through BekKari. The apartment was rented by someone named Pablo.

After we moved out, the security deposit was not returned to me and two other tenants. During our attempts to resolve the situation, Pablo told us that the deposit was still with BekKari Inmobiliaria.

Despite this, we did not feel that BekKari took meaningful action to help resolve the situation or recover our deposit.

Based on our experience, I would recommend that potential tenants be very careful, keep records of all payments and communication, and clarify in writing who is holding the security deposit before renting a property.

This review reflects our personal experience and the statements made to us during the dispute.

The chicken was extremely salty, served with a handful of fries. We at least expected some vegetables to come with it. The paella was the biggest disappointment. It was also extremely salty with the whole bottom being burnt. The portion was also very underwhelming for a 48€ dish. My experience with Orlando García of ORGACÓN OBRAS Y REFORMAS SLU was terrible. He left the renovation unfinished, with numerous tasks still pending.
During the project, I paid in advance for items that hadn't even been completed, there were days without any workers, and I ended up handling things myself, like delivering materials and checking orders.

My main advice: DO NOT blindly trust the payments you're presented with. Check which tasks are listed as completed and verify that they've actually been done before paying. In my case, the architect Cristina Gómez Ruiz of Hubara Proyectos Inmobiliarios and Orlando had worked together previously.
I also had problems with the keys: Orlando accessed the property outside of the hours I had authorized, missed two agreed-upon deliveries, and finally sent them via the post office with an incorrect address. I only got them back because the post office contacted me.

I've attached photos showing the condition of the property: bathrooms without mirrors or electrical fixtures, materials already purchased but never installed, baseboards still missing, a bathtub surround not attached, and other unfinished details.
I have contracts, messages, payment receipts, and photos to support my account.
After this experience, I would never hire Orlando García or ORGACÓN OBRAS Y REFORMAS SLU again.

one_star_reviews.text:
The worst decision of my life.
My grandmother was in a nursing home a year earlier, so I know what I'm talking about.
The director is ruthless and acts on a whim. There's no stimulation, psychological support, or socialization for the elderly residents; they lack empathy and affection. The more independent residents are intimidated.

There are no protocols to prevent the spread of bacteria or viruses among vulnerable people. I saw with my own eyes how the caregivers argued about not mixing them, and in the end, it didn't happen.

They don't monitor swallowing in the case of an elderly woman over 100 years old.
The food is pre-cooked, of poor quality, and often cold.
It's impossible to speak with the doctor, and he doesn't even call you (only the nurse does). They get annoyed if you ask and never return your call.

I suggested donating a TV for the most dependent residents' room to entertain them, even if only for two hours a day, but they refused (the one they have is difficult to watch while seated...).

The terrace/garden is small, cold, and damp in winter, and it doesn't get any sun.

The staff doesn't take the elderly residents for walks, except to the bathroom. The gym is just for show. They spend all their time in armchairs. There's no physiotherapy or exercise. They excluded my grandmother from events and activities, leaving her confined to a chair. To make matters worse, weeks before, my grandmother told me they were trying to harm her, and two weeks later she developed aspiration pneumonia. :-(

It took me five months to write this review. For them, people are just livestock, a number to be replaced by the next person on the waiting list, and if someone is older and bothersome, they're just a burden... They didn't even offer their condolences. Absolute disappointment and complete distrust—that's my experience.

My apologies to the staff who try their best and can't do anything to change things. I don't mean to belittle them.

In conclusion, I regret having admitted my grandmother to the center, and my experience is as described. I hope this helps other residents.

This company is a disgrace.
On a Friday, my order showed as "out for delivery" on their tracking website. I stayed home all day waiting, and late in the afternoon, it said it couldn't be delivered because I was absent. A lie; the delivery driver neither came to my house nor called me.
I called first thing Monday morning, and they confirmed it was out for delivery and that they would deliver it. Early in the afternoon (4:30 PM), I called them again to confirm if the driver was coming. They told me they couldn't reach him. I called them all afternoon, and at 7:00 PM (when they close), they told me they still couldn't reach him. Are you supposed to believe that a company can't contact a delivery driver all afternoon?
The package was finally delivered on Tuesday, after two days of waiting. I will never again pay any online store that works with Tipsa. I feel sorry for the seller.

one_star_reviews.text:
MY EXPERIENCE AT THE NAVÀS CITY COUNCIL
I want to share my experience at the Citizens' Service Office (OAC) of this city council so that residents know how internal management works [08670 Navàs, Barcelona]. My husband (Spanish citizen) and I (Romanian citizen) went to the municipal registry office to process the registration, providing the deeds of the property we had acquired in Navàs, which is in both our names. Despite having resided completely legally in Spain for more than 20 years and having changed our address several times in the past, I had never encountered a similar situation. The worker at the window agreed to immediately process the registration of my husband and my two minor children, but flatly refused to process mine. She rudely demanded a certificate of my previous registration, ignoring the fact that I was a co-owner of the house and that my direct family was registering at that very moment. I find this criterion to be totally retrograde and absurd, in addition to applying a double standard that is totally unjustified by my origin. Finally, I was forced to travel to the other municipality to request this document that was arbitrarily required of me. The official from the other town himself was totally surprised to see the unnecessary requirement they were asking me for; He explained to me that they were inventing the rules and applying in a completely illegal way an inversion of the obligations that the law of protection and procedure does not allow. (The requirement of this certificate violates article 28 of Law 39/2015 of the Common Administrative Procedure, which prohibits requesting data that is already in the possession of the Administration, and violates the principle of data minimization of the Organic Law 3/2018 of Data Protection)
I share this story because I consider that the treatment received was shameful, lacking any logic, professionalism and empathy. Citizens who comply with our obligations deserve respect from the public administration.

During a recent trip to Menorca, I rented a vehicle via British Airways (operated by Budget). Upon collection, I inspected the car, identified a pre-existing scratch, and reported it directly to the agent on-site, who confirmed it was logged in their system.

However, after returning to the UK, an unauthorized damage charge for that exact scratch was deducted from my card. When I contacted Budget customer service to dispute the charge, I was assured the claim would be reviewed and that I would receive a follow-up call. That call never happened, and the charge remains on my account.

Booking through British Airways, I expected a reliable standard of service rather than unfair charges for pre-existing damage. To this day I'm still waiting for an update the refund for the disputed amount.

He said he wouldn't even reach the front curve, that he'd just clean the top part, and that if it's sun-damaged, he wouldn't do anything. I'll send a photo so you can see the work, which costs €40 an hour. He said he doesn't work for free. Since I live outside Córdoba, I have to take it to him at 7:00 AM and pick it up the next day at 11:00 AM. He calls me to say it's ready by 2:30 PM, that I have to pick it up. I ask him to fix a lock, and he says no, he'll install a lock that costs €120. I tell him not to install it, that I want the lock fixed, and he says it's already been quoted. The guy has the nerve of a woman. At 10:30 AM, when he calls me, I tell him not to install the lock, and he replies, "It's already installed." Now he's charging me €120 for the lock plus €50 for installation, all plus VAT. Then... He charges €48 per hour for 10 hours, polymer material €45. He tells me that for the appointment, a week in advance, I have to pay a €100 deposit. I ask for a receipt and he says no, which I found suspicious. The total bill is €702.40. I wouldn't recommend him to anyone. He sent me somewhere else, and I regret it. Look at the "professional" work for €48 plus VAT! EVERYTHING HE SAYS IS A LIE. HE'S A CON ARTIST AND ARROGANT. HE SAID HE WOULD FIX EVERYTHING STARTING SEPTEMBER 16TH. ARROGANT AND SHOW-OFF, BUT THE PHOTOS SPEAK FOR THEIR WORK AND THE FILTH HE DELIVERED THE AC. HIS RESPONSE ALREADY IDENTIFIES HIMSELF. HE GETS THE MONEY FIRST. ON TUESDAY AT 2:30 PM, HE TELLS ME HE'LL SEND ME THE INVOICE BY EMAIL THAT AFTERNOON. After several calls, I went there on Friday to get the bill. I had to wait for him to issue it. I see him as a liar and a scammer when it comes to repairs. And I'm the one who got stuck with him! one_star_reviews.text:
I’m not someone who normally gives a 1-star review, but this was honestly the worst (frozen) pizza I have ever had in my life. I absolutely do not recommend this place.

It’s no wonder the food is cheap. The pizza was extremely dry, the meat was not properly cooked, and the cheese hadn’t even melted properly. The burger was cold as well.

The fries were at least edible, although I’m hoping I won’t regret eating them later. They were very dark brown, which made me seriously question the condition of the frying oil. I would strongly recommend checking the oil.

The only thing that was actually okay was my Coca-Cola Zero.

Unfortunately, the service wasn’t much better. One of the female staff members wearing glasses looked at me so unpleasantly that I honestly felt like she was going to eat me. A smile should be a basic requirement when working with customers.

The only staff member who was genuinely friendly and helpful was the young lady who served me with a smile. She seemed to be the only person who actually had any motivation to be there.

Overall, a very disappointing experience. Based on the quality of the food, especially the meat and fries, I am seriously considering reporting this to the food safety authorities for inspection.

I would like to formally report the Global Blue refund service at Barcelona Airport.

The way customers are being treated is completely unacceptable. Recently, my family member processed a Tax Free refund at the airport. The total refund amount was approximately €2,400, but instead of paying the equivalent amount in euros, the airport Global Blue counter paid only USD 2,100 and then required an additional €79 payment to receive the cash.

This means the customer suffers a significant loss simply because Global Blue forces the refund into USD and applies an extremely unfavorable exchange rate. The difference is not clearly explained to customers, and the process feels misleading and unfair.

I strongly request that Global Blue investigate the practices at the Barcelona Airport counter, explain exactly which exchange rate and fees were applied, and provide a proper resolution for the amount that customers have lost.

I am extremely disappointed with this experience and expect a serious response rather than a generic explanation.

one_star_reviews.text: My experience with Conforama and their supplier Allmobel has been absolute hell. I would not recommend either of these companies. I ordered a basic sofa bed chaise lounge with storage on June 28th with a 10-14 day delivery window. It is now Aug 20th and I still do not have the sofa. After the 14 day window I messaged for a status update and they told me the couch was not in stock. This already was upsetting that they didn't let me know this at the time of purchase. Message, after message, after message. thenn they told me my sofa shows a status of delivered. I assured them that I have no sofa, it has not been delivered. They kept confusing my rug delivery with the sofa deliver. I received the rugs but not the sofa. After that I kept getting different delivery messages but no delivery. Finally an Allmobel delivery team shows up on Aug 13th and delivers boxes with terrace furniture in them that I did not order. I noticed this as soon as they left my apartment and I called them back immediately. They asked me to send them pictures of what I actually ordered so I did that and by then they would no longer answer my calls to come and pick up these boxes that do not belong to me. I still have these boxes sitting in my living room as if I am a storage warehouse for their products. I have countless email messages back and forth with Conforama customer service, constantly asking me the same questions over and over again. Every single day I am messaging with them to please come and pick up this furniture that was delivered to me in error and refund my money for the original sofa I ordered. They will not comply. I have done everything they have asked, writing at least 5 status forms regarding my issue, providing them my order number and information, which they should already have. This is the worst customer service and care I have seen since working with Sklum. I am looking for the Spanish government business complaint process to initiate that today as I still have no sofa and no refund. This is insane.

one_star_reviews.text: I bought a pool filter from them two years ago, and they installed it. This year the pump broke. We contacted them, but there was no response. The men who installed it say they no longer work for them, and the company isn't answering. Now the filter lid and the chlorinator have broken... I've tried contacting them again, and still nothing. Don't buy from them; they don't provide technical service. I went to stores to replace the chlorinator, and they told me that no one distributes that brand anymore, that it's poor quality, and that they don't sell it. In short: between having problems at the beginning of the season that they didn't fix, and having to spend €500 to have a new motor installed myself, and now, in mid-August, the chlorinator has burned out... they're not responding, and I can't find the part... I'm going to be without a pool for half the summer season. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY AT ALL.

The pool filter is of poor quality, and there's no after-sales service. In the middle of summer, our two-year-old filter broke down, and no one is offering a solution. They don't have technicians to repair it, they don't have spare parts, and what's worse, the parts are so poor quality that they aren't sold in pool supply stores anywhere. In the middle of summer, they tell us to excuse them, saying they're on vacation and working with minimal staff, with no one in charge to contact... but a company that specializes in pools... when do they expect us to need to contact them? In winter? I don't believe the good reviews are genuine... impossible with the experience we're having.

one_star_reviews.text:
I want to share my experience because I think it's significant.

Have you ever felt like you were in a movie with idiots? I have, just this morning, when I went into the Immigration Office to get a question answered. Since there's a guard at the entrance, I greeted him and asked how to make an appointment for a certain procedure, as I was passing by and the last time I made an appointment for the same thing, they gave them out right there, but that was over 10 years ago.

I asked him a short question, loudly and clearly. He looked at me without blinking and said, "What?"... I repeated the question, and he gave me the same answer. This happened about four times. On the fifth time, I changed the word order in the sentence and practically spelled it out for him, and he told me again that he hadn't understood me. I assure you, it was like talking to a broken record that only knows how to say one word. It occurred to me that maybe he has some kind of disability or there must be some explanation, since what happened wasn't normal. I speak perfect Spanish, and I assume the security guard did too, although he didn't seem to understand. After the sixth attempt to ask the same question, I gave up and told him it didn't matter. As I turned to leave, he finally understood me and even answered my initial question, handing me a slip of paper with the website to book the appointment I wanted myself. You can't even imagine how ridiculous the situation was. I think he was pulling my leg; I can't find any other explanation. It was one of those moments where, as it's happening, you feel like looking to see if there's a hidden camera.
Impossible to get in touch with them! They don't answer the phone or reply to emails. Then you make the trip and they say you can't do anything without an appointment! A disaster!
The treatment of people who have been contributing to the system for years is appalling and unacceptable. State employees should lead by example.

I took my car to the garage on August 19, 2026. The brake light failed the MOT test.

They told me it was the light switch (solenoid valve). They replaced it, but that wasn't the problem, and the brake light still didn't work. They told me it was the bulb holder for the left brake light. According to them, Renault doesn't supply it, so they contacted a scrapyard. They told me they would have it replaced between Thursday and Friday of that week. I contacted them on Thursday, and they told me they wouldn't have it until Monday, but that they had already paid for the bulb and would install it on Monday. On Monday, I went to pick up my car and found that after paying the bill, which detailed that they had replaced the solenoid valve and the bulb, I discovered that the bulb was the one I had installed because my original bulb was damaged.
Since they charged me for a bulb, I demanded to see the bulb they had charged me for. They told me it was already installed, and I showed them that it was my original bulb. And since he charged me for it, I asked him to give me the pilot light he hadn't installed. It turned out the problem wasn't with the solenoid valve or the pilot light. Now I have a spare pilot light. Beware of this workshop.

one_star_reviews.text:
In short:
Chaos, wasted time, and a half-empty tank. Enterprise, never again.

Long story:
I use Enterprise services often, and I rented a car right here in Bilbao last time with absolutely no issues. This time, however, it was honestly the worst car rental experience of my life.

Right after arriving, I found the main desk closed with just a paper sign directing me to the 4th floor. The nearest elevator wasn't working, and once I finally got upstairs, there were absolutely no signs. I wasted a lot of time wandering around in the wrong direction. All of this could have been avoided if they had simply notified me about the location change in the email.

When I finally found the branch, the car wasn't ready, and the staff took forever just to find the keys. The grand finale was the departure itself—the garage barrier wouldn't open. The intercom password I was told to use didn't work either, meaning I had to walk back to the desk twice just to get them to open the gate. Instead of quickly heading to my hotel, I lost nearly an hour of precious time.

To make matters worse, I found out today that the car was not handed over with a full tank. Due to the immense stress and rush from the previous delays, I unfortunately didn't check the fuel gauge during pickup. However, after driving only 80 km, I have just a 1/4 tank left.

Even though I have been a loyal customer until now, after this completely unprofessional experience, my conclusion is simple: National Enterprise Global, never again.

one_star_reviews.text:
The owner gives the Eumesa Hotel across the street permission to go ahead of everyone else, as if the rest of the people waiting respectfully in line don't matter at all. And the hotel manager treats the employee very badly in front of everyone, just to make it clear that they have permission. They leave mountains of laundry there with the hotel's cart. It's terrible service. If they don't need to make money, they could leave the key with the hotel so people don't have to wait hours to wash their things. I can't give it 0 stars. Furthermore, with the largest washing machine constantly occupied by the hotel's laundry, other people have to queue for the two remaining ones, the smaller and the medium-sized ones. I had to do two loads of laundry, and I was left with dirty clothes that didn't get in, pay more, wait three times as long (because the dryer was clearly also full of the hotel's laundry), and pay even more. I don't understand this madness.

UPDATE FOLLOWING THE OWNER'S RESPONSE:

I feel it's necessary to clarify something, as their response comes more than a year after my review and, furthermore, directly contradicts what I described.

The customer service line was indeed called, several times, and no one answered. And I wasn't the only person present or the only one experiencing this situation: there were several people waiting, including two regular customers who live next door and who told us they had previously contacted the owner about similar situations and, as they explained, hadn't received adequate treatment either.

Therefore, saying now that "I should have called" doesn't solve anything: calls were made and there was no response.

My review describes exactly what I witnessed that day: Hotel Eumesa staff walking past those of us who were waiting and large amounts of hotel laundry filling the machines, including the largest washing machine and later the dryer. That's what happened in front of several people, and it was precisely the reason for my review.

That more than a year later the response is simply to claim that my account “isn’t true,” without them having been there or spoken to me at the time, seems particularly unfortunate. A professional response would have involved inquiring about what happened or clarifying the situation; directly discrediting a customer’s experience doesn’t change what occurred.

I stand by my review and rating because they accurately reflect my experience that day.

I'm posting photos from my wedding, some are even from before the wedding itself started… and a picture of what I wanted: finger waves, which I got done another day at a different salon. I have long, healthy, beautiful hair… I invest a lot in it. I got married in Sierra Quilama, and this was the closest thing to it. I asked for American waves/finger waves, and well… I got what you see. Hair that looked dirty, all tangled up… they didn't even give me a straight part. I wish I had styled it myself… even gone natural… now I look at the photos, and it's just awful.
When I got to the hotel, I had to do my makeup and the photos, and I didn't have time to wash, dry, and style my hair… so there was no way around it. It was the happiest day of my life, but in not a single photo do I look beautiful, nor do I see the gorgeous hair I always dreamed of having on my wedding day and that I take such good care of. I saw the salon's photos on Instagram and almost canceled, but I didn't want to do it myself in case I was nervous… IF YOU'RE THE BRIDE, SERIOUSLY, DON'T GO. Learn to do a nice hairstyle yourself. You have time to learn, enjoy it, and do it yourself. Seriously, don't let what happened to me happen to you, and don't let your wedding photos end up like this. If I could go back, I'd pay 500 euros to avoid being touched by this salon.

And I'm sorry because I don't like to mess with anyone's business, but it was the most important day of my life, and what you did to me was a disaster… my hair looks better any day I get out of the pool and let it air dry.
Besides, when I went to pay, you charged me more than you quoted me on the phone.

Reply: No. I never left the salon with beach waves; they were just regular waves. My last photo is of beach waves from a different salon.

one_star_reviews.text:
I'm giving it one star because I can't give it zero. I booked an appointment at this clinic to get a quote for orthodontic treatment, after having been assured beforehand that the consultation and quote were completely free and without obligation.

After going in for a consultation and having some photos taken of my mouth, I was seen in the office by the manager/head, Carolina. As is logical and prudent with any medical treatment, my intention was to compare prices and options at several clinics before making a decision.
The unpleasant surprise came when I left, when at reception they demanded I pay more than €100 for the visit. When I expressed my disagreement and reminded them that they had guaranteed it was free, they sent me back to Ms. Carolina's office. Far from offering a professional solution, the head's attitude was absolutely arrogant and inappropriate, even going so far as to ask me dismissively if the reason I didn't want to pay was "because I didn't have any money."

An unacceptable, classist comment whose sole purpose was to embarrass me in order to try and charge me for something we hadn't agreed upon. I obviously refused to pay a single euro for a service they advertised as free.
I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. They lack transparency in their fees, use deceptive tactics to attract clients, and their treatment of patients when they assert their rights is appalling.

one_star_reviews.text:
A regrettable and utterly disappointing experience. Be very careful with this construction company.

We reserved a property through a real estate agency in Toledo and clearly agreed on both the price of the property and the deposit amount. This amount was even confirmed during a second visit.

The day before signing, upon receiving the contract, we discovered that the deposit had been doubled. After several calls, the real estate agency acknowledged the situation and confirmed that the agreed-upon amount would be honored. However, on the very day of signing, they informed us that the builder had decided to charge double.

The day you sign the deposit for your first home is supposed to be a beautiful and exciting moment. In our case, they managed to turn it into the complete opposite.

When we spoke directly with him, his behavior was arrogant, unpleasant, and completely inappropriate. He even told my partner that if we didn't know what we were signing, we shouldn't have reserved anything. He even went so far as to criticize and discredit the employees of the real estate agency itself.

Obviously, we did not proceed with the transaction. Buying a home requires trust, integrity, and keeping your word, and our experience with this construction company has been the complete opposite.

If you're going to deal with them, get EVERYTHING IN WRITING and review every document down to the last detail. Verbal agreements seem to have no value when it comes time to sign.

For us, it was an experience we would never repeat, and we cannot recommend this construction company.

one_star_reviews.text: The worst experience I've ever had with a service. It all started between February and March of 2026. I requested an appointment to learn about the intragastric balloon. I was seen by the consultant they had at the time (Laura), the only "human" person I met there. She convinced me to undergo the treatment, I started the tests, measurements, etc., and they told me I was a candidate. They gave me financing options for the treatment, and I decided to finance the nearly €6,000 through Banco Sabadell's finance company. They scheduled the endoscopy for March, and everything seemed to be going well. A week or so before the procedure, they informed me that I couldn't go alone, which I disagreed with because I wanted to keep it secret and under my own responsibility. They insisted to the point that I decided to cancel the treatment and sent them an email to put my decision in writing. After not receiving a response, I called them, and they told me I had to meet with the clinic director, a woman named Beatriz. I met with her the next day, and it was all very cold. She raised objections and even threatened me with having to pay for part of the surgery and materials, and even with undergoing another treatment with injections. I disagreed, and she finally informed me of the procedure for officially canceling my contract. At that point, they were already charging me the financing installment. I completed the cancellation process through the link they provided, and from then on, there was silence. I began calling the clinic repeatedly, but nothing was resolved. They kept giving me the runaround and empty promises. Time continued to pass, they kept charging me for the financing, and in one of those calls to the clinic—I insist, I know—they told me that Beatriz was no longer running the clinic, but rather someone named Ilya. I managed to get through to him, and again, I received many promises and empty words. And then, silence once more. In July 2026, I decided to return the payments the bank allowed me to make, and almost immediately the finance company was sending me messages saying they would charge me a surcharge and threatening to put me on a defaulters list. I informed the clinic, and a woman named María José contacted me via WhatsApp. I never really understood her role at the clinic. She told me we would repeat the cancellation process in writing because the problem was that Dorsia's headquarters was very slow with these processes, and she hoped this would expedite the procedure. I did so immediately, and again, there was silence. I repeatedly told María José, almost begging her, to please speed things up because I was afraid of being put on a defaulters list. That was in August 2026. In September 2026, the finance company threatened me again, charged me a surcharge, and I paid it out of fear. I informed the clinic, which ignored me, and here I am, leaving this negative review because I feel completely abandoned. More than €800 lost later, and with no response from Dorsia regarding a refund for a treatment that was never performed, they are beyond disgraceful. I feel scammed. Update to review dated September 30th: At the beginning of September, a woman named María José called me and assured me via WhatsApp that the financing had been canceled and that I would receive a full refund. She also offered me some sessions at the clinic as an apology, and if I was happy with the results, I should remove this review. A month passed, and I received nothing. I managed to speak with the finance company, and they told me they had no record of the cancellation. That's when I became suspicious. A few days later, I received a message from the finance company saying they were trying to collect the month's payment and that if I didn't pay, they would put me on a defaulters list. I wrote to Maria José and not a single word of apology; she completely ignored me, showing not the slightest empathy for a dissatisfied customer. It's deplorable. I demand a refund.

Terrible handling of the service cancellation. They cancelled the treatment and, to this day, have not refunded the amount paid. They also offer no clear solutions through their customer service channels. It is unacceptable to have to resort to filing formal complaints or using external channels to recover money for a service they themselves cancelled.

⭐ 1 STAR — Very disappointing experience with Neptuno Car Hire

Our rented car would not start because of a battery problem, leaving us stranded. At the time, I did not have the rental contract with me, so I did not have the emergency number available. We had no choice but to call a taxi, if not, my friends would miss their flight.

When I later contacted Neptuno to claim the insurance, the owner told me that I could no longer claim because I should have called the emergency number when the car broke down.

I understand that this may be their procedure, but there is a serious problem: I later tried calling the emergency number myself, even though we no longer needed assistance — and the number was INVALID.

This means that even if I had somehow had the number available and called it when the car broke down, we would apparently still have ended up having to find our own transportation because their emergency number was not working.

I also sent Neptuno an email explaining the situation, but I received no reply.

The most frustrating part is being refused an insurance claim because I didn't follow a procedure that, when I subsequently tried to test it, could not actually be used because the emergency number provided was invalid.

A breakdown can happen with any rental car. What matters is how the rental company responds and supports its customer.

In our case: the car failed, we had to pay for a taxi, the emergency number provided was invalid, our email was ignored, and our insurance claim was rejected.

Very disappointing customer service. I would not rent from Neptuno again.

one_star_reviews.text:
One star. An unacceptable standard of care and accuracy during an urgent family matter.

We instructed this notary’s office to prepare powers of attorney for my elderly parents. From the outset, they knew that my mother was terminally ill, unable to attend the office and had very little time left.

Despite these circumstances, the drafts contained numerous errors: incorrect names, wrong addresses, incorrect references to the person granting the power, and wording that did not reflect our instructions. Important legal provisions concerning the scope and continuing validity of the powers also required clarification and revision.

These were documents intended to allow us to manage our parents’ affairs during illness and organise my father’s relocation abroad. Precision was essential. Instead, I had to spend hours checking successive drafts, identifying mistakes and repeatedly requesting corrections while my mother was dying.

The signing arrangements were repeatedly changed or postponed. On 21 September, the office acknowledged that it had given us incorrect information about the notary’s availability and moved the proposed visit to the following day. Further uncertainty followed over when each parent’s power could be signed. A subsequent home appointment was expressly confirmed for 28 September at 2:00 p.m. At 1:22 p.m. that day—less than an hour beforehand—we were informed that the notary would probably not have time to finish reviewing the documents and that the signing would again be postponed, without a replacement date.

On 29 September, with my mother deteriorating rapidly, I felt compelled to set a formal deadline and state that I would complain to the Colegio Notarial de Galicia. The powers were finally signed that day.

When we collected the documents on 1 October and paid the invoices in cash, we were not even given a signed receipt acknowledging the cash payment. After everything that had preceded it, this further undermined my confidence in the office’s administrative standards.

My mother was due to enter palliative care the following day for the final days of her life. The office knew this. Having to supervise basic accuracy, chase essential documents and repeatedly reorganise signing arrangements added an entirely avoidable burden at a devastating time for our family.

In my experience, this office failed to provide the accuracy, diligence, reliable communication and consideration that such sensitive work demands. The eventual completion of the documents does not erase the distress caused by the process.

I would not use this office again and cannot recommend it, particularly for urgent matters involving elderly or seriously ill relatives.

one_star_reviews.text:
Part One.
I made a large purchase of a divan bed, mattress, and pillows, and they sent me a delivery message for August 14th between 3:00 and 8:00 PM. The order included assembly, but when the delivery drivers arrived, they told me they wouldn't assemble the divan bed. I made them return all the items. Then, they indicated in another message that they would resend the order on August 20th between 3:00 and 8:00 PM. However, they didn't come, they didn't call, and they didn't contact me at all. I have no response and am very disappointed with their service. What a terrible company. 👎👎👎
Part Two.
On August 26th, the delivery drivers arrived with the order. The same ones who had told me the first time that they didn't have assembly instructions, but this time they did. Oh well. Suspecting something was amiss, I went down to the building entrance to check on the order. They were leaving the materials there and removing the protective packaging—the cardboard and plastic wrapping—leaving the bed frame, its panels, etc., exposed. I noticed that the bed frame panels were chipped and the boxes were all deformed and broken. I asked the worker why they were removing the protective packaging, and he was very attentive. The man replied that it was to make it weigh less and that he wasn't a pack mule. Given the situation, I had no choice but to ask them to take it away. The lack of professionalism, not only of the company but also of its employees, is appalling. Of course, I have canceled the order. Emma Mattresses must be thrilled with this situation. 👎👎👎

one_star_reviews.text: I've been coming to this pharmacy for two years, and the service has always been excellent and the staff very friendly, but that changed today. I went in to see if I could return a cream, as it was prescribed for something I don't actually have, and the doctor has since changed my diagnosis. The cream was completely sealed and in perfect condition, and I even had the receipt from seven days ago. I understand and accept that returns aren't accepted due to salinity issues, whether I like it or not. But what infuriates me isn't that, but rather the way the person (a redheaded woman) who served me treated me. She showed zero empathy and was utterly arrogant. Knowing it wasn't possible, she didn't ask me why and didn't waste my time, which is exactly what she did. If you work with the public, especially in a pharmacy, you need to develop that sense of empathy and kindness that she clearly lacks, and I urge her to do so, as there are ways to communicate effectively. I won't be returning simply to avoid seeing her face.
